title: Wonderful Guide
text: Natalia was an expert, personable and effective guide through the Sagrada Familia.   We had a wonderful experience.   Thanks from Nashville TN USA.
author: M9015DOjeffk

title: That semi private means a...
text: That semi private means a group of 12. Other Viator tours I’ve taken only had 6 people. I was disappointed that there were so many in our group. Natalia was an excellent guide and very knowledgeable about the basilica.
author: Linda_C

title: Imagination and vision realized - a great tour
text: Natalia was a terrific tour guide with an encyclopedic knowledge of the Sagrada Família and Antonio Gaudi’s life.   She was patient, delightful and clear with her explanations.
author: karenaY7573KD

title: Great Tour and Fantastic Guide
text: The tour was great and Natalia was a fantastic tour guide. She was engaging and extremely knowledgeable. Our small group was able to easily navigate around the site and learn about the history and architecture of the Sagrada Família. Having the “whisper ears” was super helpful because we were able to look around and take photos while listening to Natalia’s information.
author: pezster

title: Awesome and worth the money
text: Awesome guide and really enjoyed the visit
author: Keeno123

title: Fantastic Guide memorable tour
text:
This was well worth waiting . I and my wife have been planning a visit to Sagrada Família since long . We chose a guided tour and were very fortunate that we got Natalia as our tour guide . Natalia is such a charming a person that we were in instant rapport with her . She took us to every nook and corner of this magnificent monument and explained architectural and historical aspects in details. Never tired of our questions and always responding keenly to our requests for a photo shoot ! 

We will always remember her smiling face and warmth .
author: Naveen_T

title: Fantastic tour!
text: Natalia provided an excellent tour for our family four (two boys, ages 11 and 13).  She engaged the adults and children really well, and she was extremely informative. Would recommend this tour to anyone!
author: mgabes27

title: Worth the extra expense
text: It was the best way to see the inside of Sagrada Família with the least frustration and wait time. Guide was very accommodating. My husband needed a wheelchair and it was quickly provided. Would highly recommend this tour to get the most out of the experience.
author: Donna_C

title: Philippe was absolutely...
text: Philippe was absolutely first class. His passion for the architecture and history was extremely evident throughout the whole tour. He went out of his way to make this an amazing experience. I would say he is the best guide we have had on Viator.
author: Robert_S

title: Beautiful architecture that mixed with math, math, mathematics and nature and Bible bring out the beauty of this work.
text: Philippe did a great job describing the basilica and giving us his personal experiences.   It was really nice looking at the differences in architecture from 100 years ago with a vision with mathematics nature and the Holy Spirit being present.
author: dougmeyers15
